as_told.title: Farmington Armada witness: too many to count

plain: In 1950, the story goes, half the town of Farmington, New Mexico watched hundreds of silver discs swarm across the sky, an event later known as the Farmington Armada. Michels tells it himself, without naming a source, as part of a tour of the region. A witness who is not named, and who says they saw it, gives a slightly different picture: "The first day there were a few. The second day there were too many to count." So the witness describes it over two days, a handful of objects at first and then a sky full of them. The story matters to those who tell it because, if true, a whole town saw a mass of unknown craft at once.
